lines: * [CHANGE] Reject empty values for `-blocks-storage.tsdb.float-chunk-encoding` and the per-tenant `float_chunk_encoding` setting. Use `xor` or `xor2`, or omit the per-tenant setting to inherit the global value. #16718
* [CHANGE] Distributor: `PushWrappers` must finish reading decoded request data before calling `next`. Copy values needed for post-push processing before forwarding the request. #16676

+* [CHANGE] Ingester: `cortex_ingester_ingested_samples_total` no longer counts samples that the TSDB drops at commit time because their series already has a sample at the same timestamp. Previously, every sample accepted at append time was counted as ingested, including these. Samples rejected at commit time for other reasons, such as out-of-order samples, are still counted. The dropped samples still count toward the `-ingester.instance-limits.max-ingestion-rate` limit and user stats, since they cost the full write path. #16347

* [CHANGE] Query-frontend: The PromQL extended range selector modifiers `smoothed` and `anchored` are now always enabled. The `-query-frontend.enabled-promql-extended-range-selectors` flag and `enabled_promql_extended_range_selectors` per-tenant setting are deprecated and have no effect, but remain accepted for configuration compatibility. #16618
* [CHANGE] Query-frontend: PromQL duration expressions are now stable and remain always enabled. #16618

* [CHANGE] Rename the experimental `-ingester.float-chunk-encoding` flag to `-blocks-storage.tsdb.float-chunk-encoding` because it applies to the ingester, block-builder, and compactor. The per-tenant `float_chunk_encoding` setting is unchanged. #16544

* [FEATURE] Ingester: Add experimental label churn detection, which shows the label names whose values create the most new series on the `/ingester/tsdb/{tenant}/label_churn` page. Enable it with `-ingester.label-churn-enabled`. #17080 #17403

* [FEATURE] Store-gateway: Add the experimental `-blocks-storage.bucket-store.posting-offsets-in-mem-sampling-cardinality-threshold` flag to reduce the memory used by loaded index-headers for high-cardinality labels. Disabled by default. #17421

* [FEATURE] Querier: Add the experimental per-tenant `-querier.metadata-default-time-range` limit. When set, the series, label names, label values and search endpoints use the current time for a missing `end`, and `end` minus this time range for a missing `start`. The response includes a warning that shows the default range. When unset, behaviour does not change. #17464

+* [ENHANCEMENT] Ingester: Samples that the TSDB drops at commit time because their series already has a sample at the same timestamp are now counted in `cortex_discarded_samples_total`. Previously, these drops weren't counted under any reason. Exact duplicates (same timestamp and value, for example from client retries) use the new reason `same-value-for-timestamp`, and conflicting values that are only detected at commit time use the existing reason `new-value-for-timestamp`. The drops are also attributed per series in cost attribution. #16347

* [ENHANCEMENT] Ingester: The `/ingester/ring` page links each ingester to its `/ingester/tenants` page, set with the experimental `-ingester.ring.status-page-ingester-link-template`. The `/ingester/tenants` page shows and sorts by the head series of each tenant. The `/ingester/tsdb/{tenant}` page links to the label churn of the tenant when it's enabled. #17285
* [ENHANCEMENT] API: OTLP translation headers (`-api.otlp-translation-headers-enabled`) are now stable and no longer experimental. The flag remains disabled by default. #17076
* [ENHANCEMENT] Store-gateway: Emit exponential native histograms for `cortex_bucket_stores_blocks_sync_seconds` alongside existing classic buckets. #17077
